ResearchProjectDef.label: archotech androidtech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Techniques for cannibalizing salvaged archotech artifacts and grafting them into android chassis. True archotechnology cannot be manufactured by human hands - but an intact vanometric power cell, psychic emanator, or archite capsule can be dismantled, re-housed, and wired into an android's subsystems with sufficient understanding of both the artifact and the chassis.
